entry.title: The book’s view of pacifiers
entry.summary: The authors discourage constant pacifier use while also acknowledging a possible reduction in SIDS risk and allowing limited use for settling or sleep. Their position is not an absolute ban.
entry.cue: You are reading about pacifiers in the Montessori approach.
detail: Their concern is that something constantly in the mouth can limit opportunities for sounds and communication. The same discussion recognizes that a pacifier may help an unsettled baby or a baby falling asleep.
The book also includes considering a pacifier at naps and bedtime in its 2021 sleep-safety box. These parts belong together when understanding the authors’ view.
